title: Correct refractive index
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be √3 or its decimal equivalent (approximately 1.732).

title: Correct propagation time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 5a/(2c) or its simplified equivalent (e.g., 2.5a/c).

title: Applies Snell's Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Snell's law (n = sin θ_i / sin θ_r) using the identified angles of incidence and refraction.

title: Identifies key angles
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly identify the angle of incidence (60°) and refraction (30°) at the internal point where the beam changes direction.

title: Calculates path length
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the total path length (EF + CF) inside the prism using geometry, resulting in a length proportional to 'a'.

title: Relates speed and index
description: Important: The solution must correctly relate the speed of light in the prism to the refractive index (v = c/n).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expression for time should have correct units (e.g., a/c) indicating dimensional consistency.

title: Misidentifies angles
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly identifies the angles for Snell's law (e.g., using 30° and 60° in the wrong positions).

title: Arithmetic or algebraic error
description: Pitfall: Penalize for significant arithmetic mistakes in calculating the refractive index, path length, or final time, even if the setup is correct.
